caption: Figure 4: Flock Relay Per-Invocation Protocol. Certificates denote the signing entity in the circle. Teal denotes serverless- to-relay (S2R); green denotes serverless-to-serverless (S2S).
subject: the two-phase TLS handshake protocol Flock's Relay uses to connect two serverless instances without exposing them to each other directly

groups.why_chosen: Flock's Relay authenticates each serverless instance separately (teal S2R) before downgrading and re-forwarding their sockets so the instances complete a direct mTLS handshake (green S2S) end-to-end.
groups.what_to_learn: A lifeline walkthrough with no numbers at all: top-down order plus two phase colours
